description: SCSA (Scientific Cyber Security Association) is a cybersecurity organization delivering penetration testing, security audits, and Information Security Framework development, alongside professional and corporate training courses, and applied research. Our penetration testing services are authorized by the Digital Governance Agency (DGA) of Georgia, ensuring trusted and compliant security assessments. We combine real-world attack simulations with education and innovation—offering hands-on courses, ethical hacking hackathons, and research-driven insights to strengthen both organizational security and cybersecurity talent. We also support organizations in meeting regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR and international security standards. Contact us for security services, training programs, or collaboration.
